resources.string: Off: backups stay in Google Drive\'s hidden app area, which can\'t be shared.
On: backups are in \"My Drive/Zyll 相册\" (encrypted, random file names), so albums can be shared.
Will move to a visible folder tonight when the phone is charging, on Wi‑Fi and idle. You can still change your mind until it starts.
Will move back to the hidden area tonight when the phone is charging, on Wi‑Fi and idle. You can still change your mind until it starts.
Moving backups: %1$d / %2$d. This can\'t be changed until it finishes; it pauses when you use the phone and continues another night.
Almost done: removing the old copy. This can\'t be changed until it finishes.
Some backups are in Zyll\'s visible folder and need one more Google Drive permission (files Zyll created). Zyll asks for it when needed.
Moving is in progress. You can change this after it finishes.

This takes effect right away:

• New backups go straight to a visible folder "Zyll 相册" in My Drive. Contents stay encrypted and file names are random, but you'll see the folder in Drive. Don't delete or move it.
• Older backups in the hidden area are moved at night (while charging, on Wi‑Fi and idle), which may take several nights; once fewer than 100 are left, they're moved as soon as you're on Wi‑Fi.
• Older photos not yet moved can still be viewed and downloaded, just not added to shared albums yet.
• You can undo until moving starts at night; once it starts, wait until it finishes.
• Other devices on this account must first be updated to version 0.1.5 or later (only then can they find files after they're moved). After that they'll switch automatically.

This takes effect right away: new photos go back to Google Drive\'s hidden area, and backups in the visible folder are moved back at night (or as soon as you\'re on Wi‑Fi once fewer than 100 are left). Albums you\'ve shared will stop working for others. You can undo until moving starts; once it starts, wait until it finishes.
OneDrive\'s app folder is already visible, so OneDrive accounts don\'t need to move.
Share an album with your partner, friends or colleagues; end-to-end encrypted
Only an album key is shared, never your password or master key. The other person can use the Zyll app or the web version (photo.zyll.top), with an account on the same cloud drive.
Send this to people who want to share an album with you. Compare the safety code with them in person or by phone.
No encrypted backups yet. Turn on end-to-end encryption and back up first.
Members can view and download originals (otherwise previews only)
Only backed-up, encrypted photos can be shared. On Google Drive, album sharing must be turned on in Cloud backup first.
Owner\'s safety code: %1$s. Check it with them before joining.
Connect an account on the same cloud drive first.
This isn\'t a Zyll invite link.
Everyone loses access and the shared folder is deleted. Your photos stay in your own backup. Photos others already downloaded can\'t be taken back.
I\'ve checked this code with them
This isn\'t a Zyll share card.

I\'ve shared the album “%1$s” with you on Zyll. Copy the link below, then in the Zyll app go to Me → Shared albums → Join an album. The link fills in by itself (or paste it). With a OneDrive account you can also just open the link in the web version. Google accounts can only join in the app for now:
This is my Zyll share card. Copy the link below, then open the album in the Zyll app (Me → Shared albums) or in the web version, and tap Invite. The link fills in by itself (or paste it):
Will also be able to add photos to the album (coming soon)
Can also add photos, invite and remove members, and change permissions. To remove photos, use the web version for now
They lose access and the album key is changed. Photos they already downloaded can\'t be taken back.
Turn on album sharing in Cloud backup and wait until the move finishes.
Sharing needs end-to-end encryption to be on and unlocked on this phone.
You don\'t have permission to do that in this album.
This album\'s data has been changed by someone who isn\'t allowed to. It won\'t be opened.
Can\'t open this album: you haven\'t been given access yet, or the owner removed you.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
Can\'t read the backup list in the old location, so moving is paused. Check the connection, or unlock encryption on this phone.
Another phone started moving this account\'s storage but hasn\'t made progress for over 3 days. Until it finishes, this phone won\'t upload new photos here.
Stop waiting, back up as usual
You still own %1$d shared album(s). If the library goes back to the hidden area, members can no longer open them. Go to Me → Shared albums, open each one and choose Stop sharing, then turn this off.
If that phone later continues moving, this phone will go back to waiting for it. Photos uploaded here in the meantime will be carried over when it finishes.
Couldn\'t confirm whether you own any shared albums: the cloud drive couldn\'t be reached, or this phone hasn\'t unlocked encryption yet. Check the connection or unlock encryption, then try again.
Getting your shared albums back from the cloud drive…
Some shared albums may be missing: couldn\'t reach the cloud drive or unlock the library.
Couldn\'t read this album right now. Please try again later.
Someone else just changed this album. Please try again.
Backup data is being deleted, so shared albums cannot be changed right now.

On: new photos go straight to the visible folder. %1$d older backups will be moved at night (or as soon as you\'re on Wi‑Fi once fewer than 100 are left). Photos not yet moved can still be viewed and downloaded, just not shared yet. You can undo before moving starts.
Off: new photos go back to the hidden area. %1$d backups will be moved back at night (or as soon as you\'re on Wi‑Fi once fewer than 100 are left). You can undo before moving starts.
New photos will go to the hidden area again. Photos already in the visible folder will be moved back at night.
New photos keep going to the visible folder, and backups not yet moved back stay where they are.

Turning sharing on or off moves backups into or out of Zyll\'s visible folder in Google Drive, so Zyll needs one more permission (files Zyll created) for %1$s first. Once every listed account has allowed it, this continues automatically. Choose the same account.

%1$s has sharing turned on, so its backups are in Zyll\'s visible folder in Google Drive. To keep using this account on this phone, allow one more Google Drive permission (files Zyll created). Choose the same account. If you don\'t want to allow it, disconnect this account; your backups in the cloud stay as they are.
Backups already in the cloud stay as they are. Photos that are only in this account (not on this phone or in another account) will disappear from the gallery until you reconnect.
Access wasn\'t granted. Check your network and try again.
The permission for files Zyll created wasn\'t allowed. On the Google page, keep “See, edit, create, and delete only the specific Google Drive files you use with this app” checked.
